description: World Cup starters who must be in their nation's pool of that era (compiler input, scripts/compile-legends.mjs): regulars of sides that mattered at the tournament whom the best-26-by-rating rule leaves out. Each takes the place of the lowest-rated player of his line in the pool; his card is EA's, unchanged. `sofifaId` is EA's player id, `sourceName` a word of his name in the data — the build fails when the id has no card for that nation in that era or the name does not match.
